info.title: AI Stylist API
info.description:
Public API of the AI Stylist backend. URI-versioned (`/v1`); changes within `v1` are additive.
Errors are RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` with a stable machine `code` from
`@ai-stylist/shared-kernel`.

tags.name: platform
tags.description: Health, version and other non-domain endpoints

tags.name: identity
tags.description: Sign-in, sessions, account recovery and consent

get.description: Returns `ok` when the API and every checked dependency are reachable.

503.description: One or more dependencies are down

get.summary: Build identity of the running API
get.description: Semantic version, commit SHA and build timestamp of the deployed API.

post.summary: Sign in with an Apple or Google identity token
post.description:
The app runs the provider's native sign-in and sends the identity token it received.
The server verifies the token with the provider's keys, then answers with one
`SignInResult`: a session for an existing account, `sign_up_required` for an identity
with no account (nothing is stored until `completeSignUp` accepts the birth year), or
`deletion_pending` for an account inside its deletion grace window (no session). No
provider token is ever returned.

post.summary: Complete a pending sign-up with the self-declared birth year (age gate)
post.description:
Second part of a sign-up. The first part is a sign-in whose answer was
`sign_up_required`; the `signUpToken` of that answer authorizes this call. The server
applies the age gate (16+, DEC-60) to the birth year. Accepted: the account is created
and the answer is the `session` outcome. Refused: `AGE_GATE_FAILED`, nothing about the
attempt is stored, and the sign-up token is spent; a new attempt starts again with a
sign-in. Identity's own operation: better-auth 1.7.12 has no path for it.

401.description: `UNAUTHENTICATED`: the sign-up token is missing, expired, already spent or unknown. Start again with a sign-in.

403.description:
`AGE_GATE_FAILED`: the birth year lies fewer than 16 years back (DEC-60). Terminal
for this attempt: nothing is stored and the sign-up token is spent. The client shows
its refusal screen and offers no way to change the year.

get.summary: WebAuthn options for a passkey sign-in
get.description:
Returns a fresh challenge and the WebAuthn request options (W3C WebAuthn
`PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptionsJSON`) for the platform passkey API. Without a session
no credentials are listed, so the device offers its discoverable passkeys.

post.summary: Sign in with a passkey assertion
post.description:
Verifies the assertion the platform passkey API returned for the challenge of
`getPasskeySignInOptions`. Answers `session`, or `deletion_pending` for an account inside
its deletion grace window. A passkey always belongs to an existing account, so this
operation never answers `sign_up_required`.

get.summary: WebAuthn options to add a passkey to the signed-in account
get.description:
Returns a fresh challenge and the WebAuthn creation options (W3C WebAuthn
`PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptionsJSON`). The account's existing passkeys are listed as
excluded credentials. Needs a recently created session (better-auth `freshAge`);
otherwise 403 `FORBIDDEN`, and the client signs in again first.

post.summary: Add a passkey to the signed-in account
post.description:
Verifies the attestation the platform passkey API returned for the challenge of
`getPasskeyRegistrationOptions` and stores the passkey on the caller's account. An
account may hold several passkeys. Opens no new session.

get.description:
The account and expiry of the session the bearer token belongs to. Read-only: it does
not extend the session (better-auth `deferSessionRefresh`). A token with no live session
is answered with 401, never with an empty body.

post.description:
Extends the session the bearer token belongs to and answers with its token and new
expiry. The answer may carry a different token than the one presented: the client
stores the returned token and discards the old one. A 401 here is a refused renewal:
the client ends the session on the device and sends no further call for it.
Revokes the session the bearer token belongs to on the server.

get.summary: List the signed-in devices of the caller
get.description:
One entry per active session of the caller's account (the device list, doc 11 §4.2),
newest first, cursor-paginated (doc 06 §2). Never another user's sessions and never a
session token.

200.description: One page of the caller's sessions

post.description: Revokes every session of the caller's account, the current one included.

200.description: Every session of the account is revoked

post.summary: Ask for an account-recovery link by email
post.description:
Fallback for a person who lost their passkeys (doc 11 §15). The answer is the same
status and body whether or not an account exists for the address, so it discloses
nothing. When one exists, a single-use link is emailed; it works from 24 to 48 hours
after the request, and any signed-in session of the account can cancel it before then
(`cancelAccountRecovery`). Never creates an account.

get.description:
Exchanges the token of a recovery link for a sign-in. Refused before 24 hours and from
48 hours after the request, after a cancel, and on a second use. The person then adds
a new passkey with `registerPasskey`. The server never logs the query string of this
path.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Single-use token from the emailed link.

401.description: `UNAUTHENTICATED`: the link is unknown, used, cancelled, not yet valid or expired.

delete.description:
Cancels the pending recovery link of the caller's account during its 24-hour delay.
Only a signed-in session of that account can cancel; holding the mailbox is not
enough. Identity's own operation: better-auth 1.7.12 has no path for it.

204.description: The pending recovery is cancelled; its link no longer works.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: the account has no pending recovery.

get.summary: The caller's current consent per purpose
get.description:
The latest consent record of each purpose the caller has decided on, cursor-paginated.
A purpose with no record is absent and its default applies (doc 11 §7.2). The full
append-only history is part of the data export.

200.description: One page of current consent records

post.summary: Grant or withdraw consent for one purpose
post.description:
Appends a consent record for one purpose (doc 11 §7.1; append-only: a withdrawal is a
new record). 201 when a record was appended. 200 when the request repeats the current
state for the same policy version: nothing is stored and the current record, with its
original dates, is returned.

403.description:
`CONSENT_REQUIRED`: a withdrawal of `core_service` is refused. This consent is
required to use the app (doc 11 §7.2). Deleting the account is what ends this
processing (`POST /v1/me/deletion`).

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 problem details (planning/06 §2). `code` is stable and machine-readable.

code.description: Stable machine code from the shared-kernel error registry

errors.description: Field-level validation failures with JSON-pointer paths

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON pointer into the request body

version.description: Semantic version of the deployed API

commit.description: Git commit SHA the build was produced from

IdentityProvider.description: Identity providers that sign in with a native identity token (DEC-64).

token.description: The provider's identity token (a JWT), verified against the provider's keys.

nonce.description:
The unhashed nonce the app generated for the provider request. The identity
token's `nonce` claim must equal it or its SHA-256 digest. Sign in with Apple
requires it.

user.description: Name the provider reports to the app on the first authorization only (Sign in with Apple).

UserId.description: Account id, a prefixed ULID (`usr_`, shared-kernel `ID_PREFIXES.user`).

SessionGrant.description: A session the server opened or renewed.

token.description: The session token for `bearerAuth`. Kept in the Keychain or Keystore-backed storage only (doc 11 §4.2).

expiresAt.description:
When the session ends unless renewed with `refreshSession`. The server may refuse
the token earlier (revocation, or a shorter access window, doc 11 §4.2); the client
then renews once.

DeletionPending.description:
The account is inside its 7-day deletion grace window (DEC-65): no session was opened.
The only thing the client can do is offer to cancel the deletion with `cancelToken`.

graceEndsAt.description: End of the grace window; the purge starts after it.

cancelToken.description: Value for the `Deletion-Cancel-Token` header (`deletionCancelToken`); valid only for `DELETE /v1/me/deletion`.

SignUpPending.description:
The verified identity has no account. Nothing is stored. The client asks for the birth
year and calls `completeSignUp` with `token`.

token.description:
Sign-up credential for `CompleteSignUpRequest.signUpToken`. Single use, valid only
for `completeSignUp`; it opens no session and grants nothing else.

SignInResult.description:
One sign-in outcome. `outcome` names it, and exactly the object of that outcome is
present: `session` for `session`, `deletionPending` for `deletion_pending`, `signUp` for
`sign_up_required`. Only `session` opens a session.

birthYear.description:
Self-declared birth year (DEC-60). Only a sanity range is enforced here; the age
floor is the server's rule and is never restated by a client.

Base64Url.description: Base64url without padding (RFC 4648 §5), as WebAuthn JSON encodes binary values.

PasskeyExtensionInputs.description:
WebAuthn extension inputs (`AuthenticationExtensionsClientInputsJSON`). Only the
extensions this API requests are modelled.

PasskeyExtensionOutputs.description:
WebAuthn extension outputs (`AuthenticationExtensionsClientOutputsJSON`). Only the
extensions this API reads are modelled; send `{}` when there are none.

name.description: Label the person gives the passkey.

PasskeySummary.description: A passkey stored on the account. Carries no key material.

SessionInfo.description: The current session, without its token.

needsRefresh.description: True when the server asks the client to renew now with `refreshSession`.

DeviceSession.description: One signed-in device of the caller. Carries no token and no IP address.

current.description: True for the session that made this request.

userAgent.description: The `User-Agent` the device sent at sign-in, to tell devices apart.

nextCursor.description: Cursor of the next page; null on the last page.

status.description: Always true, whether or not an account exists for the address.

ConsentRecordId.description: Consent record id, a prefixed ULID (`cns_`, shared-kernel `ID_PREFIXES.consentRecord`).

ConsentPurpose.description:
Consent purpose keys of doc 11 §7.2, in that order. Mirrors shared-kernel
`CONSENT_PURPOSES` value for value (pinned by packages/contracts/tests/kernel-enums.test.ts).

PolicyVersion.description: Version of the policy text the person saw, e.g. `0.1.0-draft`.

ConsentSurface.description: Identifier of the app screen where the decision was made, e.g. `onboarding_consent`.

Locale.description: BCP 47 language tag of the text the person saw, e.g. `en-GB`.

grantedAt.description: When the consent was granted; present when `status` is `granted`.

withdrawnAt.description: When the consent was withdrawn; present when `status` is `withdrawn`.

nextCursor.description: Cursor of the next page; null on the last page.

SignInRefused.description: `UNAUTHENTICATED`: the identity token or passkey assertion was not accepted.

RateLimited.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: a rate limit was hit (doc 11 §14); retry after `Retry-After` seconds.

Unauthenticated.description:
`UNAUTHENTICATED`: the credential is missing, malformed, expired or revoked. The client
renews the session once (`refreshSession`); if the renewal is refused too, it signs in
again.

Forbidden.description:
The caller is authenticated but may not perform this operation. `code` is `FORBIDDEN`
unless the operation names a more specific code for this status.

AccountDeleted.description:
`ACCOUNT_DELETED`: the account is deleted or its deletion is in progress. The client
erases everything it stores for the account and returns to its signed-out start; it
tells this reply from 401 by the status alone. A 410 is cacheable by default
(RFC 9110 §15.5.11), so the reply carries `Cache-Control: no-store` and must not be
cached.

bearerAuth.description:
Session token issued by a sign-in (`SessionGrant.token`), sent as
`Authorization: Bearer <token>` (doc 06 §2). Opaque to clients: never parse it. A
missing, malformed, expired or revoked token is answered with the `Unauthenticated`
(401) problem. The client then renews once with `refreshSession`; a refused renewal
ends the session on the device.

deletionCancelToken.name: Deletion-Cancel-Token
deletionCancelToken.description:
Cancel credential of the `deletion_pending` sign-in outcome
(`DeletionPending.cancelToken`), sent in the `Deletion-Cancel-Token` header. Its only
use is `DELETE /v1/me/deletion`, the cancel of an account deletion inside its 7-day
grace window (DEC-65); every other operation refuses it. Single purpose, and valid for
at most 15 minutes from issue, no longer than an access token (doc 11 §4.2); the exact
expiry is `DeletionPending.cancelTokenExpiresAt`. It opens no session. A header of its
own, not `Authorization`, so it can never be taken for a session token.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description:
Client-generated ULID that makes a mutating request safe to retry (doc 06 §2; the
mobile mutation-log `opId`). The server keeps key, request hash and response for 48 h:
a replay with the same body returns the stored response, the same key with a different
body is refused with 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`. Optional for the caller.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the `nextCursor` of the previous page; omit for the first page.

CacheControlNoStore.description: Always `no-store`; the response must not be stored by any cache.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (RFC 9110 §10.2.3, delay-seconds form).
